**Tesla Model S – India**

> **Official status:**  
> Tesla has not yet launched a Model S (or any vehicle) in India, so there is no official price listed on the Tesla website or by any authorized dealer.

> **What you can expect (rough estimate):**  
> If Tesla were to import the Model S into India, the price would likely be driven by:
> * Import duty (currently around 100 % on EVs, though this could change with new policies)
> * GST (18 % on imported cars)
> * Additional state‑level taxes and fees
> * Shipping, handling, and logistics costs

> Taking the U.S. base price (~$90 k) and applying roughly 200–250 % total tax and duty, the ballpark figure would be **₹1.5 – 2 crore** (≈ $200 – 250 k).  
> This is purely an estimate; actual pricing could differ once Tesla announces its launch strategy and any changes in Indian tax policy.

> **Bottom line:**  
> Until Tesla officially enters the Indian market, there is no confirmed price for the Model S in India. Keep an eye on Tesla’s announcements and local news for updates.
